#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    vector<long long> digits(32, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i) {
        digits[i] = m % n;
        m /= n;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i) {
        long long d = digits[i];
        if (d <= 1) continue;
        if (d == n || d == n - 1) {
            digits[i + 1] += 1;
        } else {
            cout << "NO" << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    cout << "YES" << endl;
    return 0;
}
